title: Susan Gough's psychological operations role as a source for the WSJ article
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Susan Gough's psychological operations role as a source for the WSJ article, about 2025 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Booz Allen Hamilton / Department of Defense, USA

tellings.quote: One of the articles primary sources is Susan Gough, whose own LinkedIn, along with independent sources, confirms her lead role in Booz Allen Hamilton's Psychological Operations Consulting Practice for the Department of Defense.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says one of the main sources for a 2025 Wall Street Journal article on UFOs was a woman named Susan Gough. He says her own LinkedIn profile and other sources show she led the psychological operations consulting work, meaning work on shaping what people believe, at Booz Allen Hamilton, a large consulting firm, for the US Department of Defense. Michels raises this because, in his view, it would cast doubt on the article's reliability.
